raw_text: URGENT: Heavy firing reported along LoC in Poonch sector. Multiple mortar shells landed near forward posts around 0230 hrs. Villagers in Shahpur and Kirni areas reporting explosions. Indian Army retaliating. This is the first major ceasefire violation since the 2021 agreement.
